clue.text: There's some depression about the pages being spotty

indicators.note: about means going round, so the hollow is wrapped around the pages

parts.note: a dale is a valley, a low-lying depression in the land
pp is the standard abbreviation for pages

explanation.surface: Someone dejected reads blotchy pages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' is a link word, and 'about' is the container indicator; 'depression' looks like low spirits but is a hollow in the land.
explanation.definitionFit: Dappled means marked with spots or patches of colour, as on a horse's coat.

clue.text: Report of the French writer

parts.note: de is the French word for 'of'
a scribe is one who writes, a copyist or author

explanation.surface: A news report from a French author.
explanation.definitionFit: To report something is to give an account of it, which is to set it out in words.

clue.text: With little money, the working man is prejudiced

parts.note: p is the abbreviation for a penny, a small amount of money
an artisan is a skilled manual worker

explanation.surface: A poorly paid worker holds biased views.
explanation.definitionFit: A partisan view is one-sided, biased towards a party or cause.

clue.text: Sustained hunger

definitions.meaning: lasting a great while, as in a sustained or drawn-out effort
as a verb, to yearn or crave for something

explanation.definitionFit: Lengthy and enduring is one sense; to yearn, as a verb, is the other.

clue.text: Concern for profit

definitions.meaning: something that engages one's attention or stake
the money earned on a loan or deposit

explanation.definitionFit: A stake or concern in something is one sense; money paid for the use of money is the other.

clue.text: What may well be assumed by women preparing for retirement

definitions.text: What may well be assumed by women preparing for retirement

parts.words: What may well be assumed by women preparing for retirement
parts.note: retirement here is going to bed, not leaving work, and 'assumed' means put on

explanation.surface: Something women take on as they approach the end of their working lives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retirement' suggests leaving a job; here it is retiring for the night, and 'assumed' means put on, as clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Garments worn in bed are put on by women getting ready to sleep.

clue.text: The peer left with a listening device first

indicators.note: first tells us the hearing organ is placed before the letter for left

parts.note: the ear is the organ we listen with

explanation.surface: A nobleman goes off wearing a hearing aid.
explanation.definitionFit: An earl is a British nobleman, a member of the peerage.

clue.text: One following another team?

definitions.meaning: the figure 1 written after another 1 makes 11
a cricket or football side has this many players

explanation.definitionFit: Writing the digit 1 after another 1 gives the number, and a football or cricket side fields that many players.

clue.text: Those persons holding gold as a speculation

indicators.note: holding means containing, so the pronoun wraps around the heraldic metal

parts.note: they is the pronoun for those persons
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: People with gold as an investment gamble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as a' is a link; 'holding' is the container indicator, and gold as 'or' comes from heraldry.
explanation.definitionFit: A theory is a conjecture or supposition, an idea put forward without proof.

clue.text: Jumped un when a policeman telephoned

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Jumped un when a policeman telephoned' (OCR): RANG is telephoned, but no reading of 'un when a policeman' gives SP, and no scan or search shows the printed words.
annotationWithheld.clue: Jumped un when a policeman telephoned

clue.text: Give trouble to change-giver in time

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters within the word for a period of time

parts.note: an age is a long period of time

indicators.note: change tells us to rearrange the letters of the following word

explanation.surface: Upset the person handing out change, in good time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' looks like coins tied to the giver; it is the anagram indicator, making GRIEV, and 'in' is the container indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: To aggrieve someone is to distress or wrong them.

clue.text: Professional man in a train-ever so well-organised

indicators.note: these letters are put into a neat new order, so they are anagram fodder

explanation.surface: A professional on a train that is remarkably well run.
explanation.walkthrough: 'so well-organised' rearranges IN A TRAIN EVER into the twelve letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal doctor is a qualified professional who treats pets and livestock.

clue.text: Getting a painter in would be wet!

definitions.note: the wet is a noun for wet weather

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword's usual painter
taken as written

explanation.surface: Hiring a decorator would bring damp weather.
explanation.walkthrough: RA, a Royal Academician, is the usual crossword painter; 'Getting' and 'would be' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Falling water from clouds is what people mean by 'the wet'.

clue.text: Mouth a letter

definitions.meaning: where a river meets the sea, fanning out into channels
the fourth letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.definitionFit: A river mouth spreading into silt channels is one sense; the Greek letter D is the other.

clue.text: Brew right drop

parts.note: a brew is a pot or cup of tea

explanation.surface: A drink that is just the thing, down to the last drop.
explanation.definitionFit: A drop of liquid from the eye when crying is called by this word.

clue.text: Go round for some clothing

definitions.meaning: to pass around the edge of something
a garment hanging from the waist

explanation.definitionFit: To pass around the edge of an obstacle is one sense; a garment hanging from the waist is the other.

clue.text: Drink obtained by rail

parts.note: per means by, as in per post
Ry is the abbreviation for railway

explanation.surface: A beverage got hold of on the train.
explanation.walkthrough: 'obtained' is a link word; RY is an old abbreviation for railway.
explanation.definitionFit: Perry is an alcoholic drink made from fermented pears, like cider from apples.

clue.text: Lacked breath to get involved though feeling wicked

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so these letters are jumbled together

explanation.surface: Someone out of breath yet feeling evil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get involved' mixes the letters of LACKED BREATH; 'though feeling' links them to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone black-hearted is malicious and evil.

clue.text: When properly cooked, eat green produce

indicators.note: cooking here means working the letters into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Kitchen advice: cook vegetables right before eating them.
explanation.definitionFit: To produce something is to bring it into being or create it.

clue.text: They're forever breaking down

parts.note: breaking down here means taking apart to examine, not collapsing

explanation.surface: People who are always in tears or falling apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaking down' suggests collapse; here it means splitting a thing into its parts to study it.
explanation.definitionFit: Analysts dissect data or problems into components for examination.

clue.text: A capital operator!

parts.note: capital refers to the head, and operator to a surgeon

explanation.surface: Praise for a first-rate worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like 'excellent'; it is the head, from Latin caput, and the operator is a surgeon working on it.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgeon who operates on the brain works inside the head.

clue.text: A Greek island doctor's creation

parts.note: Cos (Kos) is an island in the Dodecanese
MO is a medical officer, so doctor's gives MOS

explanation.surface: A Greek island physician's handiwork.
explanation.definitionFit: The cosmos is the universe seen as an ordered creation.

clue.text: The dealer is a little schemer-certain to cheat a guy

indicators.note: only a little of these words is used, the run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: A trader turns out to be a petty schemer, bound to swindle someone.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs through 'scheMER-CERtain'; 'to cheat a guy' completes the picture and gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A mercer is a dealer in textiles, especially silks and fine fabrics.

clue.text: Surplus, it's concluded

definitions.meaning: finished, as in the game is ended

explanation.definitionFit: Excess or left-over is one sense; finished and done with is the other.

clue.text: Mother managing a stud farm?

parts.note: read as a word for one who pairs animals for breeding, as well as the Latin word for mother

explanation.surface: A mum who runs a horse-breeding business.
explanation.walkthrough: Latin for mother, read also as 'one who mates' animals, which a stud farm does.
explanation.definitionFit: Mater is Latin and old public-school slang for one's mother.

clue.text: Strip off in the Isle of Man

definitions.meaning: to remove an outer layer or skin
a town on the west coast of the island

explanation.definitionFit: Removing the skin of fruit is one sense; a west-coast town on the Isle of Man, a self-governing island in the Irish Sea, is the other.

clue.text: Financial institution causing a row

definitions.meaning: a business holding deposits and making loans
a tier or row of keys, oars or switches

explanation.definitionFit: A firm holding deposits is one sense; a row of things such as switches or oars is the other.

clue.text: Lock up silver in the church

indicators.note: in puts the metal inside the letters for the church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Secure the silverware in the church.
explanation.definitionFit: To confine someone or something behind bars is to imprison them.

clue.text: Skilled worker giving men a chic new look

indicators.note: giving these letters a new look rearranges them

explanation.surface: A tradesman giving men a stylish makeover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new look' (Dior's style name) rearranges MEN A CHIC.
explanation.definitionFit: A mechanic is a skilled tradesman who repairs machinery.

clue.text: People putting a lyric into writing

indicators.note: into places the song inside the abbreviation for writing

parts.note: MS is a manuscript, a piece of writing
a lay is a short lyric poem or song

explanation.surface: Writing down the words of a song.
explanation.definitionFit: Malays are a people of the Malay Peninsula and surrounding islands.

clue.text: Memorable industrial action

definitions.meaning: noticeable and impressive, so lingering in the mind

explanation.definitionFit: Arresting and impressive is one sense; a walk-out by workers is the other.

clue.text: About a hundred, and a character-has created a niche

parts.note: re means about or concerning
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
ess is the name of the letter S

explanation.surface: A centenarian of some character has carved out a place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' and 'has created' are links; ESS is the letter S spelt out.
explanation.definitionFit: A recess is an alcove, a hollow set back into a wall.
